# koota-kit

> Small, production-derived conventions for deterministic simulations built
> with [Koota](https://github.com/pmndrs/koota): one lifecycle boundary, two
> independent seeded RNG streams, safe object-valued traits, and
> world-scoped event logs. Not a game engine — it doesn't hide Koota's
> queries, entities, relations, or actions.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jonbogaty.com/koota-kit/): the published,
  browsable version of everything below.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/koota-kit/blob/main/README.md): install,
  quick start, core concepts, persistence boundary, error behavior.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/koota-kit/blob/main/docs/API.md):
  full signatures and validation behavior for every export.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/koota-kit/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  module boundaries, invariants, performance choices, intentional limits.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/koota-kit/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  toolchain, invariants not to violate, and doc/test sync obligations for
  an autonomous coding agent working in this repository.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/koota-kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  local setup, the `pnpm verify` gate, commit and release conventions.
